description.en: The ID of the region where the resource is located.

description.zh:
资源类型。取值范围：

- ContainerGroup：ECI实例
- ImageCache：镜像缓存
- DataCache：数据缓存
- VirtualNode：虚拟节点
description.en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

- ContainerGroup: ECI instance

- ImageCache: image cache

- DataCache: data cache

- VirtualNode: virtual node

description.zh: 标签列表。一个资源最多可以绑定20个标签。
description.en: The list of tags. You can attach a maximum of 20 tags to a resource.

description.zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The key of the tag. The key cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The value of the tag. The value can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000 --tag Value=testvalue Key=testkey --resource-type ContainerGroup --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000' --Tag.1.Key testkey --Tag.1.Value testvalue --ResourceType ContainerGroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
